protocol.cache_state: OS cache warm after preparation and graph fingerprint reads; process cold for load, warmed for measured query batches

readiness.name: all-graph-node-census
readiness.query: MATCH (n) RETURN n.graphId AS graph, count(n) AS nodes ORDER BY graph

cases.name: network-message-call-scan
cases.query: MATCH (c:CallSite) WHERE toLower(coalesce(c.caller_class, '')) CONTAINS 'message' OR toLower(coalesce(c.callee_class, '')) CONTAINS 'request' RETURN c.graphId AS graph, count(c) AS calls ORDER BY graph

cases.name: literal-call-provenance
cases.query: MATCH (s:StringConstant)-[:DATAFLOW]->(c:CallSite) RETURN c.graphId AS graph, c.callee_class AS callee, c.callee_name AS method, count(s) AS literalArguments ORDER BY literalArguments DESC, graph, callee, method LIMIT 100

cases.name: field-type-inventory
cases.query: MATCH (f:Field) RETURN f.graphId AS graph, f.type AS fieldType, count(f) AS fields ORDER BY fields DESC, graph, fieldType LIMIT 100

cases.name: shared-wire-literals-prefiltered
cases.query: MATCH (a:StringConstant) WHERE a.value IN ['application/json', 'Content-Type', 'GET', 'POST'] WITH a MATCH (b:StringConstant) WHERE a.graphId <> b.graphId AND a.value = b.value RETURN a.graphId AS leftGraph, b.graphId AS rightGraph, a.value AS wireLiteral, count(*) AS pairs ORDER BY leftGraph, rightGraph, wireLiteral

environment.compilerIndex: Xcode 15.4 for Signal; Swift 6.1.3 for SwiftPM
environment.measurementBoundary: existing index through saved graph; compilation is preparation

diagnosticOnly.hypothesis: Test process/run variability using identical candidate binary SHA in both labeled slots before attributing original A/B regression to code.
diagnosticOnly.fixedSamplePlan: Three paired rounds, labels AB, BA, AB: six fresh server processes. Both labels use exactly candidate binary b089844defbf59bbad8670f156199f1fed07f63dd19321966d467b933b4cefa6. Keep all four cases, five warmups, 100 requests/case at concurrency 1 then 4. Same final three graphs and complete response consumption. Use corrected Mach-tick CPU harness. No adaptive extra runs or removal of original samples.
diagnosticOnly.analysis: Report all six process distributions, pair deltas, whole range and exact parity; no acceptance claim, no best-round substitution. Focus join absolute p50/p95 and per-batch CPU. A/A variability tests stationarity, not equivalence of main and candidate.
diagnosticOnly.followup: If A/A stable, predeclare separate reversed-label A/B with candidate in baseline slot and main in candidate slot for two paired rounds, holding binaries/graphs/settings fixed. If A/A unstable, preserve failed original gate; instrument environmental/core scheduling state or capture focused profiling before more acceptance runs.
diagnosticOnly.environmentRecording: Record safe relevant env overrides (RAYON_NUM_THREADS,TOKIO_WORKER_THREADS,MALLOC_CONF,_RJEM_MALLOC_CONF),power/thermal snapshot and system background process CPU before/after each process. No builds/tests or other benchmark on host during experiment. No unrecorded affinity/QoS/allocator tuning.
